messages:
violet: PR opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1902 — update Lyra-Embed model card: clarify supported variants, add shard-sizing example, and include short Python + JS snippets for batched embeddings.

harry: paste the proposed limits row?

violet: variant | seq_limit | recommended_shards
lyra-embed-v2 | 4096 | ~1 shard per 90 QPS (measured avg prompt 32 tokens)
lyra-embed-v2-q4 | 4096 | ~1 shard per 72 QPS (~15-22% perf delta)

sam: nit: change wording to 'approx.' and add bench link. also add migration note for SDK v3 param names.

violet: bench link added https://bench.redwood/runs/1902-lyra. snippets below:
```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
c.embeddings.create(model='lyra-embed-v2', input=['a','b'], batch_size=16)
```
```javascript
import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'
const client = new Redwood()
await client.embeddings.create({model: 'lyra-embed-v2', input: ['a','b'], batchSize: 16})
```

preview-bot: preview deployed — https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.io/docs/model-cards/lyra-embed (status: success) :white_check_mark:

harry: fixed broken anchor to /docs/guides/sharding-estimates. LGTM, approved.

violet: merged. changelog: 'Lyra-Embed v2: clarified shard sizing, added SDK snippets and bench links.'
